name: Monte Carlo 2D Voxelization
definition: A differentiable method for converting a 2D triangle mesh (defined by vertices and edges) into a volumetric occupancy grid using Monte Carlo integration of the generalized winding number, with optional adaptive sampling and stratified sampling.
summary: Monte Carlo 2D Voxelization converts 2D triangle meshes into volumetric grids using stochastic sampling of the generalized winding number, enabling adaptive strategies and gradient propagation.
